hero_kpi_rationale: The Consumer segment represents 77% of total revenues and is the primary growth driver, fueled by 5G, fiber, and fixed wireless access (FWA), making it the key KPI despite the absence of a significant technological wow factor.

kpis.explanation_en: Revenues generated from individual customers through mobile telephony, fiber, and fixed wireless internet access.
kpis.description: The Consumer segment saw revenue increase by 3.8% in 2025, driven by 5G adoption, the ramp-up of FWA, and fiber network expansion.
kpis.signal: Croissance solide portée par la 5G et la fibre

kpis.explanation_en: Revenues from enterprise services, including IoT connectivity, private networks, and security.
kpis.description: The Business segment declined by 1.6% in 2025, reflecting pressures on corporate spending and increased competition.

kpis.explanation_en: Annual spending to develop and maintain networks, particularly fiber and 5G.
kpis.description: Verizon invested 17 billion USD in 2025 to strengthen its fiber and wireless networks, preparing for future connectivity demand.
kpis.signal: Niveau élevé soutenu pour renforcer la couverture réseau

kpis.explanation_en: Total number of mobile lines for individuals and businesses, including FWA.
kpis.description: Verizon had 116 million consumer wireless connections and 31 million business connections as of December 31, 2025, totaling 147 million.
kpis.signal: Base client massive sur le marché américain

kpis.explanation_en: Total number of households and businesses subscribed to fixed internet (fiber, FWA, DSL).
kpis.description: Verizon had 11 million consumer and 3 million business fixed broadband connections as of December 31, 2025, totaling 14 million.
kpis.signal: Croissance soutenue via la fibre et le FWA

kpis.explanation_en: Proportion of mobile lines where payment is made after usage, indicating customer quality.
kpis.description: 83% of consumer mobile connections are postpaid, indicating an engaged and more profitable customer base.
Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).

kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Résultat net de 17.174 Mds $ dernière année fiscale (FY2025).

kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven reported fiscal years.

kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital retourné aux actionnaires via dividendes de 11.481 Mds $ dernière année.

kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Part du résultat net distribué en dividendes : 66.9% dernière année.

kpis.explanation_en: Number of U.S. states covered by Verizon's 100% optical fiber network.
kpis.description: Verizon expanded its fiber network to 31 U.S. states and Washington D.C. by end of 2025, notably through the acquisition of Frontier.

kpis.explanation_en: Use of AI and cloud to virtualize and optimize networks.
kpis.description: Verizon uses AI, automation, and cloud to improve network performance and efficiency, particularly through infrastructure virtualization.
kpis.signal: Intégration stratégique de l'IA dans les réseaux

kpis.explanation_en: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares during the fiscal year. Indicates the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).
